title: The Dark Truth About Hocus Pocus 2 #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Hocus Pocus 2 — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Hocus Pocus 2 is a 2022 American fantasy comedy film directed by Anne Fletcher, written by Jen D'Angelo and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. It is the second in the Hocus Pocus film series, and features Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy, and Doug Jones reprising their roles from the first film.

The psychology underneath Hocus Pocus 2 is simpler and older than the story on top. In March 2022, it was announced that Thora Birch would not be reprising the role of Dani Dennison from the previous film. Birch later revealed she would have appeared in the film but was unable to due to a scheduling conflict.
